title: spacetime-entity-set
description: The underlying point set E_cos of a spacetime manifold, taken as the entity set of the settling — each element a cosmic event. Not a bare set: it carries a causal partial order ≼ (e₁ ≼ e₂ iff e₂ is in e₁'s future light cone), a proper-time metric along timelike worldlines, and (in FLRW) a cosmic-time projection t : E_cos → ℝ≥0. A continuum, handled by continuum predication (a sheaf of bilattice values) or coarse-graining.

of-spacetime.description: the spacetime manifold whose points this is

cosmic-events.description: each element e ∈ E_cos is one cosmic event (the carrier of the cosmic-event role)

causal-order.description: the causal partial order ≼ from the light-cone structure, plus proper-time and (in FLRW) a cosmic-time projection carried as side data
